name: com.reromanlee.transvoxel
description: Clean, modular implementation of Eric Lengyel's Transvoxel algorithm for Unity (URP) with seamless LOD triangulation of a density field managed by an octree for large, editable, real-time landscapes.

samples.description: A ready-to-play scene: fly camera, terraforming brush, and a UI Toolkit panel that drives every terrain setting live - including the ones that rebuild the world. Ships a four-material palette with albedo and height maps so triplanar and parallax occlusion are visible out of the box. Needs the Input System package and Active Input Handling set to 'Input System Package' or 'Both'.
